scope: Post-evaluation lessons for a future frozen experiment; not read to retune V3.

lessons.outcome: Causal event features and close-fixed integer orders are verified by protocol tests; full vintage data and auction matching still unavailable.
2026 champion reduced drawdown/turnover relative to matching legacy control, but mean excess intervals crossed zero and R2 remained negative.
LW alone did not generally outperform sample covariance in this four-asset experiment.

lessons.constraint: Different families choose gamma on a common validation grid; family comparisons are not fixed-gamma causal component effects.
Audit informative new data/asset domains and future windows before more search on the same 2026 outcomes.
Do not describe 2026 retrospective checks as a prospective blind trial.
